diagnosis: The API gateway proxy blindly extracts targetTenantId from client headers (x-tenant-id) or query parameters and forwards it as x-forwarded-tenant to the internal billing microservice. Because internal microservices trust gateway headers for tenant scoping, any client can access billing invoices, customer subscriptions, and credit card profiles of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/billing/invoices/latest HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
X-Tenant-Id: tenant_victim_finance_corp
